name: rentctl
description: Leased dev environments for AI coding sessions — every server dies when its session ends, so none are left running rogue.

hooks.command: if command -v rent >/dev/null 2>&1; then rent down --all --cwd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" --reason session-end; else printf '%s\n' 'rentctl: session-end cleanup did not run because `rent` is not on PATH. Install it with: uv tool install rentctl' >&2; exit 2; fi

if command -v rent >/dev/null 2>&1; then rent sweep; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage": "rentctl: the `rent` command is not on PATH, so session-end cleanup is OFF and the rentctl MCP tools will not load. The plugin runs your installed rentctl; install it with: uv tool install rentctl", "hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": "rentctl is not installed on this machine (`rent` is not on PATH): its MCP tools will not load and session-end cleanup is off. If the user wants a dev server, tell them to run `uv tool install rentctl` first. Do not start a dev server by hand as a fallback."}}'; fi
